name: m4-refchecks-joint-only

variantDescriptions.all: `203750f926` + layer A (`claude/refchecks-joint-only` `dbbb062e75`) with `-Ddotty.refchecks.memberTypes=all`: every alternative of every inherited name checked, as on main
variantDescriptions.joint: layer A on (the default): `checkMemberTypesOK` checks only joint denotations and skips `self.member(name)` for names declared in fewer than two base classes

description: Layer A of `local/PLAN-subst-matcher.md` (subst-override-matcher worktree): `RefChecks.checkMemberTypesOK` compared each inherited member's seen-from signature with a fresh copy of itself unless the member is a `JointRefDenotation`. On scalaz, dotc, tastyQuery, parallelCollections and dottyUtil there are no joint denotations; the epoch trace shows 51% fewer types over method/poly params on scalaz (12% dotc, 25% tastyQuery), output identical.

One build, two variants by `-D` (read once per JVM, so cross-fork, not paired). Plain `203750f926` with weak interners, no uncache switches. **Full pipeline** (RefChecks is after typer), ordinary GC, 8 GB heap. Graal 25.4.4, xctrace ipc, 6 rounds, M4.
